<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Market Correction:</strong> Indian indices, including the Sensex and Nifty, faced significant selling pressure in early trade as renewed US-Iran geopolitical tensions triggered a spike in crude oil prices.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>FII Activity:</strong> Despite the broader market decline, sustained buying activity from Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) has helped indices pare some of their earlier losses during the session.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwgFBVV95cUxOQ0lXa3Iwd1dSUTN6YWlGdmhRZXlkYWxlRTVLZU5mbm1pa1lyTHc0LVVzZFRnUkRhTEVJSFgwSzNLMUljZlozY0VUQ0IyOU5ramppbnBKQlFackV0eVlTUHpUcm1VOEh5TGtGOW1fQ1M3cFpQa3l2NXBGRVg1dWJSakZlYnBtU0ZPS1d0eDYxakFkaWRab2o5TzlYcThTaTVDeUVLb1FCQ1lERzh3WHJySlpzbmZjWEFGQ190dkhVUUQyZw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I14</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Inflation and Yields:</strong> The surge in crude oil prices to approximately $76 per barrel has revived inflation concerns, pushing Indian bond yields to a three-week high.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Currency Impact:</strong> The Indian Rupee weakened to 95.16 against the US Dollar as rising oil prices increased pressure on the domestic currency.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizgFBVV95cUxPX3o2VnlDSXI2d3VNQUxyUUJZanBTRFZoa2ZrcUNMUFd4WUhlaWp2RWpKZzFnWl9yczhLZ1QtbkJTOTlvOGF5cjdzRXVoU00tUEFvOUVaY0UtSkRDTzBGZVlKbGZjUmtxeldkdmQ4azBOWmI0VU54RTA4bll3dTVudWRDYmxudzV0RnRka285dFZfOXY5M0dCd2JKT0F3M2FnYnQxTC1HcUcwSjZnelVwNkRfYS1pMkhmckN2RUtBcmpBeFFZcHlUaFpxTm1EZw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W9</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Safe-Haven Assets:</strong> Gold prices remain volatile as investors weigh the impact of US strikes on Iran against upcoming Federal Reserve minutes.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W10</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxPS1hzdnRhSUFjNm5yb3RRTUlITEtOd1NMOFJJNlc0VVczR0s1S295WjY5b0YyaEhIMjZxZWEtdk5WUjlPcC05dUtFaThpNGo3QVl4REZiMzIxZ252bHE4a2VRRjFUYXlfR3Myb0Y3aUlSVnplSEp5eW9YQjBvNXU1UmwySVFjaXhuXzNLMFBXNE5Rdk5IcWxqUXJZR3FvNGRjc2p2b3hoa2x3U2ZvOE5XYU1n?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W11</a></span></li>
